source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: A 35K-like reel plays 'Letting my husband pick my dress for a holiday party' — a metallic bronze pleated gown with a deep V and side cutouts ('struck gold,' 'Studio 54'), a black sparkly strapless gown with a thigh-high slit, and a burgundy velvet strapless mermaid dress with a bow; he picks the black one. A 14K-like reel presents three Windsor Holiday Party options — a black strapless mini with a white bow and puffy skirt, a floor-length burgundy sparkly gown with a deep V, and a black off-the-shoulder mini with a sheer train — and asks viewers to vote. A 7.5K-like 'Holiday Dress Round Up' models eight dresses, from a light-blue feather halter mini and a black sparkly halter mini to a navy off-the-shoulder mermaid gown, a gold sequined mini, a red feather mini, satin bubble-skirt dresses in black and red, and a white feather sleeveless mini. A 6.6K-like reel turns to Meta AI for a 70s-themed Las Vegas wedding guest look and lands on a lime-green sequin halter mini with gold platform heels and gold jewelry. A 4K-like 'help me pick my festive dress' reel tries an emerald green sequined gown with a black velvet bodice, a black sleeveless maxi with a sheer overlay, and a burgundy sequined midi with a thigh slit. A 3.4K-like carousel closes the night out in Manila — dark teal velvet, sequined dresses and midi skirts with slits at a mirrored-wall venue.
trends.title: Let him pick the dress — 'help me choose' reels take over party season

trends.details: A 65K-like reel documents a 'dream maximalist Christmas tree' — four days, 5,000 lights and 1,000 ornaments, vintage shiny Brite balls, Santa figures, reindeer, snowmen and glittery poinsettias packed onto a pre-lit tree under a star topper. A 35K-like reel starts the season with three friends assembling a tall artificial tree in a gold-and-white theme — oversized reflective gold baubles, gold bells, poinsettias and a star topper, plus garlands, nutcrackers and bottle-brush trees. A 17K-like carousel names the 'CHRISTMAS TREE TRENDS 2026': metallic lametta tinsel, paper chains, 'collected, not coordinated' maximalism, alternative trees, and DIY decorations. A 14K-like reel leans traditional — deep red velvet ribbons, burgundy berries, cream and gold baubles, pinecones and warm white lights under a large gold star, 'All I Want This Year is a Traditional Christmas.' A 14K-like Anthropologie/terrain carousel tours trees in red-and-white striped bows, pastel ornaments and a bright pink-themed tree. A 13K-like family tour opens on a flocked white tree with gold ornaments, red velvet bows and red berries, the family in matching teal reindeer pajamas.
trends.title: Maximalist Christmas trees take over — 5,000 lights, 1,000 ornaments, and 'collected, not coordinated'

trends.details: A 28K-like tutorial builds a 'bright beautiful snowy fairy angel' eye — a soft brown base, white concealer cut into a new lid shape, white eyeshadow packed across the lid and inner corner, Fenty Diamond Bomb pressed on top for a snowy sparkle. A 14K-like clip pairs a close-up makeup application with an Emporio Armani 'POWER OF YOU' perfume moment in front of a lit Christmas tree, fur coat on. A 7.9K-like 'Champagne Glam on a Drugstore Budget' tutorial runs a full face on e.l.f., L'Oreal, CoverGirl and Maybelline, finishing with body shimmer and a velcro roller. A 7.8K-like tutorial layers a green-and-pink duochrome shadow with dark glitter, silver metallic inner corners and KIKO MILANO mascara for a dramatic glittery eye. A 7.8K-like unboxing opens the e.l.f. 'Express Your E.L.F.' Advent Calendar — 24 doors of palettes, balms, serums and lip oils. A 7.6K-like clip pitches the Kiko Milano Twist & Twinkle Holiday Edition 3D Extreme Lip Gloss as the $16 'extra' for holiday parties.
trends.title: Snowy fairy eyes and champagne glam on a drugstore budget
